test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following government Company manages steel plants in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SAIL**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited **(SAIL) is a **government-owned steel producer**.
 
• It is **based **in **New Delhi, India**.
 
• It is under the **ownership of the Ministry **of Steel, **Government of India**.
 
• Its **annual turnover **of **INR 68,452 Crore **(**US$9.32 billion**) for the **financial year 2020–21**.
 
• Its **annual production **of **16.30 million metric tons**.
 
• **SAIL **is the **20th largest **steel **producer **in the **world **and the **largest in India**.
 
• The **hot metal production **capacity of **the company **will **further increase **and is **expected **to **reach **a **level of 50 million **tonnes **per annum by 2025**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustan Shipyard Limited **is a **shipyard located **in **Visakhapatnam **on the **east coast of India**.
 
• **GAIL Limited **is a **government-owned natural gas **explorer and **producer responsible **for **natural gas processing **and **distribution **in **India**. It is **headquartered **in **GAIL Bhawan**, **New Delhi**.
 
• **Damodar Valley Corporation **is **a government-owned power generator **that **operates **in the **Damodar River **area of **West Bengal **and **Jharkhand states of India**.
